support.fivem_installation: standard and custom paths; automatic discovery with interactive fallback
support.existing_plugins: isolated by default and restored transactionally
support.enhanced: not supported by v2 RC2; installer fails closed instead of modifying FiveM for GTAV Enhanced

hardware.fallback: Other GPUs install visual-compatibility mode (ReShade presets/UI) without claiming DLSS 5 Neural Rendering support

support.multiplayer: server plugin policy applies; no Pure Mode, anti-cheat, server restriction or ReShade restriction bypass

renodx_framework.policy: latest upstream main at build time; exact SHA recorded in BUILD-MANIFEST.json

reshade.policy: latest official Full Add-on Support resolved from reshade.me at install time; headless setup attempted against a temporary x64 host inside the target plugins directory

reshade_effects.policy: latest official packages required by shipped presets; missing proprietary effects are disabled in the installed preset rather than causing a broken default

presets.note: Existing reshade-shaders content is migrated from an isolated previous plugins folder. QuantV itself is not downloaded from unofficial mirrors.

renodx_dlss5_consumer.source: RankFTW/rhi-repo release mirror used by DLSS5-Feeder
renodx_dlss5_consumer.redistribution: downloaded at install time; not bundled

nvidia_dlss_sr.redistribution: downloaded at install time in full-neural mode; not bundled

nvidia_dlss_nr.hardware_policy: automatic full-neural mode only on detected GeForce RTX 50 Series unless explicitly forced
nvidia_dlss_nr.redistribution: downloaded at install time; not bundled

nvidia_streamline.redistribution: downloaded from NVIDIA in full-neural mode; not bundled
